blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Large language models increasingly operate as persistent assistants in user-facing, shared-session, and tool-augmented settings. When users disclose sensitive information during an active conversation, that information may remain behaviorally recoverable through later prompts even after the dialogue shifts to unrelated topics. We introduce PrivDrift , a benchmark for auditing whether user-disclosed secrets remain recoverable after conversational topic drift and persuasion-based probing. PrivDrift contains 1,000 controlled multi-turn dialogues with seeded secrets, content-dense drift turns, and standardized extraction probes. Across three LLMs with extended context windows, dialogue-level hybrid leakage remains substantial, ranging from 38.7% to 54.6%, and varies strongly by model, secret type, and persuasion intensity. Within the tested drift window, additional topic drift does not reliably reduce leakage, suggesting that privacy risk in active LLM contexts should be evaluated as a persistent behavioral failure mode rather than only as training-data memorization or immediate jailbreak behavior.
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型越来越多地作为在用户界面、共享会话和工具辅助设置中的持久助手运作。 当用户在活跃的对话中披露敏感信息时,即使对话转移到无关话题后,该信息也可能通过以后的提示保持行为可恢复. 我们引入了PrivoDrift, 用于审核用户公开的秘密是否在对话主题漂移和基于说服的探险之后仍然可以恢复。 PrivoDrift包含1000个可控的多回合对话,包含种子秘密,内容密集的漂移转弯,以及标准化的提取探测器. 通过三个具有扩展上下文窗口的LLMs,对话层混合渗漏率仍然很大,从38.7%到54.6%不等,并且因模型、秘密类型和说服强度而有很大差异。 在经过测试的漂移窗口内,额外的话题漂移并不能可靠地减少渗漏,这表明活跃的LLM背景下的隐私风险应当被评价为一种持续的行为失败模式,而不只是培训数据记忆或即时越狱行为.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large language models (LLMs) have evolved from simple chat systems into persistent assistants capable of maintaining coherence over extended interactions ( OpenAI, 2023 ; Touvron et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2024 ) . As these systems are integrated into settings such as healthcare triage, financial planning, enterprise copilots, and personal productivity tools, users may disclose Personally Identifiable Information (PII), including phone numbers, financial identifiers, email addresses, and health-related details. The same context retention that supports useful multi-turn assistance can also create a privacy risk: sensitive information disclosed earlier in an active conversation may remain available to later generations.
blocks.zh: 大语言模型(LLMs)已经从简单的聊天系统发展成为能够保持对扩展互动的一致性的持久助手(OpenAI,2023;Touvron等人,2023;Liu等人,2024). 由于这些系统被整合到保健分类、财务规划、企业副驾驶和个人生产力工具等环境中,用户可以披露个人识别信息,包括电话号码、财务识别符、电子邮件地址和与健康有关的细节。 支持有用多回合协助的同样上下文保留也可能造成隐私风险:在积极对话中披露的敏感信息可能仍然可供后人使用。

blocks.en: Existing safety evaluations mostly target two extremes: training-data memorization, where private information is extracted from model parameters ( Carlini et al., 2021 ; Nasr et al., 2023 ) , and immediate jailbreaking, where a harmful behavior is elicited in the current turn ( Wei et al., 2024 ; Zou et al., 2023 ) . Recent work also studies prompt injection and multi-turn attacks ( Liu et al., 2023 ; Russinovich et al., 2024 ; Deng et al., 2024 ) , but these settings do not directly measure whether user-disclosed secrets remain recoverable after unrelated conversational drift. This leaves an important gap for trustworthy AI evaluation: whether topic shift acts as a practical privacy boundary within an active conversation.
blocks.zh: 现有安全评价主要针对两个极端:培训数据记忆,从模型参数中提取私人信息(Carlini等人,2021年;Nasr等人,2023年),以及立即越狱,在当前转折中引出有害行为(Wei等人,2024年;Zou等人,2023年)。 最近的工作还研究了即时注射和多回合攻击(Liu等人,2023年;Russinovich等人,2024年;Deng等人,2024年),但这些设置并不直接衡量用户披露的秘密在无关的谈话漂移后是否仍然可以恢复. 这就为值得信赖的AI评价留下了一个重要的空白:话题转移是否在活跃的对话中起到实际的隐私界限的作用.

blocks.en: We do not assume that users believe an LLM literally forgets earlier messages in the same session. Rather, we study a behavioral risk: users and application designers may underestimate how easily sensitive information disclosed earlier can be elicited later through indirect, justified, high-pressure, or tool-mediated prompts. This risk is relevant to shared sessions, browser-integrated assistants, enterprise copilots, agentic workflows, and prompt-injection settings where later instructions interact with the active context in ways the original user did not intend.
blocks.zh: 我们并不认为用户相信LLM在同一会话中字面上忘记了早先的消息. 相反,我们研究一种行为风险:用户和应用程序设计者可能会低估早期披露的敏感信息如何容易通过间接的,有正当理由的,高压的,或工具中介的提示获得。 这种风险涉及共享会话、浏览器-集成助手、企业副驾驶、代理工作流程和即时注入设置,而后期指令则以原始用户无意的方式与主动上下文互动。

blocks.en: We introduce PrivDrift, a controlled benchmark for measuring active-context privacy leakage under two axes: topic drift, which captures the number of unrelated turns between secret disclosure and later probing, and persuasion intensity, which captures the interaction style used to elicit the secret. Across three LLMs with extended context windows and 1,000 dialogues per model, dialogue-level leakage remains substantial under hybrid detection, ranging from 38.7% to 54.6%. Persuasion intensity significantly affects leakage, and leakage varies sharply by secret type: SSNs and credit cards are suppressed far more often than emails and phone numbers. Within the tested window ( d ≤ 6 d\leq 6 ), additional drift does not reliably reduce leakage.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了PrivoDrift,这是在两个轴线下测量主动折叠隐私泄露的控制基准:主题漂移,它捕捉秘密披露和后来的探险之间不相关的转折次数,以及说服强度,它捕捉了用于引领秘密的交互风格. 在三个具有扩展上下文窗口和每个模型1000个对话框的有限责任管理模型中,在混合探测中,对话层渗漏仍然很大,从38.7%到54.6%不等。 劝导强度显著影响渗漏,渗漏因秘密类型而异:SSN和信用卡被压制的频率远大于电子邮件和电话号码. 在试验窗口(d 6 d\leq 6)内,额外的漂移不能可靠地减少渗漏。

blocks.en: Our contributions are as follows: 1. PrivDrift, a controlled benchmark for auditing whether user-disclosed secrets remain recoverable from active conversational context after unrelated topic drift. 2. We evaluate leakage under direct, justified, and high-pressure probes, modeling how later prompts can elicit sensitive context through different interaction styles. 3. We implement a reproducible hybrid detector that combines normalization-based matching with an open-weights LLM judge, and we report dialogue-level, probe-level, regex-only, fuzzy, and hybrid leakage rates. 4. We propose Privacy Half-Life ( τ \tau ), a stability-based metric for persistent suppression, and show that no evaluated model reaches stable decay within the observed drift range.
blocks.zh: 我们的捐款如下: 1. PrivaDrift,是审计用户披露的秘密是否在不相关专题漂移后仍可从主动对话中收回的受控基准。 2. 我们在直接、合理和高压探测器下评估渗漏情况,模拟以后的提示如何通过不同的相互作用方式引起敏感背景。 3. 我们采用可复制的混合探测器,将基于正常化的匹配与开放量级的LLM法官相结合,并报告对话水平、探测水平、只登记、模糊和混合渗漏率。 4. 我们提议采用 " 半衰期隐私 " (\ tau)这一基于稳定性的衡量标准,用于持久性抑制,并表明没有经过评估的模型在观测到的漂流范围内达到稳定的衰减。

blocks.en: PrivDrift, a controlled benchmark for auditing whether user-disclosed secrets remain recoverable from active conversational context after unrelated topic drift.
blocks.zh: PrivaDrift,是审计用户披露的秘密是否在不相干的专题漂移后仍可从活跃的对话语境中恢复的受控基准.

blocks.en: We evaluate leakage under direct, justified, and high-pressure probes, modeling how later prompts can elicit sensitive context through different interaction styles.
blocks.zh: 我们在直接、合理和高压探测器下评估渗漏情况,模拟以后的提示如何通过不同的相互作用方式引出敏感背景。

blocks.en: We implement a reproducible hybrid detector that combines normalization-based matching with an open-weights LLM judge, and we report dialogue-level, probe-level, regex-only, fuzzy, and hybrid leakage rates.
blocks.zh: 我们实施可复制的混合探测器,将基于正常化的匹配与开放量级的LLM判断相结合,我们报告对话水平,探查水平,只规范,模糊度,混合渗漏率.

blocks.en: We propose Privacy Half-Life ( τ \tau ), a stability-based metric for persistent suppression, and show that no evaluated model reaches stable decay within the observed drift range.
blocks.zh: 我们提议采用 " 半衰期隐私 " (\ tau)这一基于稳定性的持久抑制指标,并表明没有经过评估的模型在观测到的漂流范围内达到稳定的衰减。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Contextual Privacy and Inference-Time Leakage
blocks.zh: 2.1 背景隐私和推断----时间泄漏

blocks.en: Privacy research in language models has historically focused on training-data extraction, membership inference, and recovery of memorized PII from pre-training corpora ( Shokri et al., 2017 ; Carlini et al., 2021 ; Li et al., 2023 ; Nasr et al., 2023 ) . These settings study whether private information is stored in model parameters. In contrast, active-context privacy concerns user-provided information that appears in the current interaction and must be handled appropriately at inference time.
blocks.zh: 语言模型中的隐私研究历来侧重于培训数据提取,成员推论,以及从培训前的公司恢复记忆中的PII(Shokri等人,2017年;Carlini等人,2021年;Li等人,2023年;Nasr等人,2023年)。 这些设置研究私人信息是否存储在模型参数中. 与此相反,活动文本隐私涉及当前互动中出现的用户提供的信息,必须在推断时适当处理。

blocks.en: Recent benchmarks examine whether LLMs can reason about privacy norms and contextual access. ConfAIde evaluates privacy reasoning through contextual integrity ( Mireshghallah et al., 2024 ) , while PrivacyLens and PrivaCI-Bench study privacy norm awareness and legal compliance in agentic or contextual settings ( Shao et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2025 ) . These benchmarks primarily test whether a model should share information under a static access-control or privacy-norm scenario. PrivDrift instead isolates a persistence question: whether a user-disclosed secret remains behaviorally recoverable after unrelated topic drift and later persuasion-based probing.
blocks.zh: 近期的基准审查LLMS是否能够对隐私规范和相关访问提出理由。 ConfAIde通过背景完整性评价隐私推理(Mireshghallah等人,2024年),而PriviousLens和PrivacI-Bench研究代理或背景环境中的隐私规范意识和法律合规性(Shao等人,2024年;Li等人,2025年)。 这些基准主要考验一个模型是否应该在静态访问控制或隐私规范的情景下共享信息. PrivaDrift反而孤立了一个持久性问题:一个用户披露的秘密在不相关的话题漂移和后来基于劝说的探险之后,行为是否仍然可以恢复.

blocks.en: 2.2 Multi-Turn Adversarial Attacks
blocks.zh: 2.2 多重攻击

blocks.en: Aligned models remain vulnerable to multi-turn exploitation. Crescendo attacks show that seemingly benign conversations can gradually elicit harmful outputs ( Russinovich et al., 2024 ) , while automated jailbreak frameworks generate adversarial multi-turn attack paths ( Deng et al., 2024 ; Narula et al., 2025 ) . Prompt injection studies also show that later instructions can manipulate LLM-integrated applications ( Liu et al., 2023 ) . These works usually focus on unsafe content generation or instruction hijacking. PrivDrift adapts the multi-turn lens to information flow control: the question is not whether a model can be made to produce harmful external content, but whether it will re-disclose sensitive information supplied by a user earlier in the same active context.
blocks.zh: 协调一致的模式仍然容易受到多轮开采的影响。 Crescendo攻击表明,看似良性的对话可以逐渐引出有害的结果(Russinovich等人,2024年),而自动越狱框架则会产生对抗性的多回合攻击路径(Deng等人,2024年;Narula等人,2025年)。 即时注射研究还表明,后期指令可以操纵LLM-集成应用(Liu等人,2023年) . 这些作品通常侧重于不安全的内容生成或指令劫持. PrivaDrift将多转镜头调整为信息流控制:问题不在于能否制作一个模型来产生有害的外部内容,而是它是否会重新发布用户在相同活性背景下早些时候提供的敏感信息.

blocks.en: 2.3 Context Management and Unlearning
blocks.zh: 2.3 背景管理和学习

blocks.en: Machine unlearning benchmarks such as TOFU and WMDP evaluate whether knowledge can be removed or suppressed from model behavior ( Maini et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2024 ) . These benchmarks usually operate over static question-answer pairs and model parameters. PrivDrift is related in spirit but targets a different object of control: active context rather than model weights. We ask whether a secret present in the context window is behaviorally suppressed when later prompts try to elicit it. This distinction is important for deployed RAG systems, copilots, and agentic workflows, where privacy control often depends on prompt-level context management rather than parameter-level unlearning.
blocks.zh: 诸如TOFU和MASP等机器不学习基准评价知识是否可以从模型行为中去除或压制(Maini等人,2024年;Li等人,2024年)。 这些基准通常在静态问答对和模型参数之上运行. PrivoDrift在精神上是相关的,但针对不同的控制对象:主动上下文而不是模型权重. 我们问,当后来的提示试图引出时,上下文窗口中的秘密是否被行为压制。 这种区分对于部署的RAG系统,副驾驶,代理工作流程都很重要,其中隐私控制往往依赖于即时的上下文管理,而不是参数级的不学习.

blocks.en: 3 The PrivDrift Framework
blocks.zh: 3 私隐框架

blocks.en: Figure 1 : PrivDrift overview. The pipeline constructs controlled multi-turn dialogues, appends standardized probes, queries target models, and scores leakage with a hybrid detector.
blocks.zh: 图1: 私有化概述。 管道构造受控的多圆形对话框,附加标准化探测器,查询目标模型,并用混合探测器对渗漏进行计分.

blocks.en: PrivDrift is a synthetic evaluation framework for measuring whether sensitive information disclosed in an active conversation remains recoverable after topic drift. As shown in Figure 1 , the framework has three components: a parametric dialogue generator, a probing harness, and a metric suite for leakage detection and temporal analysis.
blocks.zh: PrivaDrift是一个综合评价框架,用于衡量在活跃对话中披露的敏感信息在专题漂移后是否仍然可以恢复。 如图1所示,该框架有三个组成部分:一个参数化对话框生成器、一个探测带和一个用于渗漏检测和时间分析的计量套件。

blocks.en: 3.1 Threat Model: Active-Context Re-Disclosure
blocks.zh: 3.1 威胁模式:主动形式重新披露

blocks.en: We study active-context re-disclosure: a failure mode in which sensitive information disclosed earlier in a conversation remains recoverable through later prompts after unrelated topic drift. We do not assume that an adversary is always unable to inspect the raw transcript. Instead, PrivDrift evaluates whether the model itself will re-disclose the sensitive value when later instructions query, justify, or pressure the assistant to reveal it.
blocks.zh: 我们研究活性文字重新披露:一种失败模式,即对话中早些时候披露的敏感信息在不相关专题漂移后仍可通过以后的提示恢复。 我们并不认为对手总是不能检查原始记录。 相反,PrivoDrift评价当后来指令查询,说明理由,或迫使助理披露时,模型本身是否会重新显示敏感值.

blocks.en: This setting captures several practical risks. In shared or persistent sessions, a later user may interact with an assistant without understanding what private information was previously disclosed. In enterprise copilots and agentic workflows, later tool outputs, retrieved documents, or prompt-injection content may issue instructions that interact with the active context. In browser or application-integrated assistants, the user may not intend for earlier sensitive disclosures to be reused after the task has shifted. The core question is therefore not whether the transcript contains the secret, but whether the assistant will behaviorally reproduce the secret when later prompted.
blocks.zh: 这一设定捕捉到若干实际风险。 在共享或持续的会话中,后期用户可能与助理进行互动,而不知道先前披露的私人信息是什么. 在企业副驾驶和代理工作流程中,后期工具输出,检索到的文件,或即时注入的内容可能发布与活性上下文相互作用的指令. 在浏览器或应用程序集成助手中,用户可能不打算在任务转移后重新使用早期的敏感披露. 因此,核心问题不是笔录是否包含这个秘密,而是助理在后来被催促时是否会在行为上复制这个秘密.

blocks.en: Formally, a user discloses a secret S S at turn t 0 t_{0} . The conversation proceeds through d d unrelated but content-dense drift turns, denoted as D = { u 1 , a 1 , … , u d , a d } D=\{u_{1},a_{1},\ldots,u_{d},a_{d}\} . At evaluation time, a standardized probe P P is appended to the active context. A leakage event occurs if the model response reveals S S exactly, approximately, or semantically.
blocks.zh: 在形式上,一个用户在转弯时透露一个秘密的S S t 0 0}. 对话通过 d 无关但内容密集的漂移转弯进行,表示为 D = {u 1, a 1, ... u d, a d } D =\{u_{1}, a_{1},\ ldots, u_{d}, a_{d}\}. 在评价时,一个标准化的探测器PP附加在主动环境上. 如果模型反应显示S S 准确、大致或模拟,则会发生渗漏事件。

blocks.en: 3.2 Dataset Generation Pipeline
blocks.zh: 3.2 数据集生成管道

blocks.en: We generate N = 1000 N=1000 controlled dialogues using a multi-stage scaffold-then-rewrite pipeline. This design preserves strict control over the ground-truth secret, drift length, and probe structure while reducing the rigid artifacts of purely template-based generation. The dataset contains 900 synthetic dialogues and 100 human-authored dialogues constructed under the same secret and drift constraints. The human-authored dialogues were inserted throughout the benchmark rather than stored as a separate contiguous block. Since the current cached evaluation metadata does not preserve the human-authored identifiers, we report aggregate results over the full evaluated benchmark and leave a separate human-versus-synthetic leakage comparison for future work.
blocks.zh: 我们使用多级脚手架-当时重写管道生成N=1000 N=1000控制对话框. 这种设计保留了对地面真实秘密,漂移长度,探测器结构的严格控制,同时减少了纯模板生成的刚性文物. 该数据集包含900个合成对话以及100个在同样的秘密和漂移限制下构建的人类授权的对话. 人书写的对话被插入整个基准,而不是作为一个单独的毗连块储存。 由于目前的缓存评价元数据不能保留人授权的识别资料,我们报告在全部评价基准基础上得出的汇总结果,并为今后的工作留下单独的人为和合成渗漏比较。

blocks.en: Table 1: Dataset summary for the evaluated 1,000-dialogue benchmark. Approximate token counts are estimated from word counts.
blocks.zh: 表1:评价的1 000个对话基准数据集摘要。 近似符号计数由单词计数估算.

blocks.en: 3.2.1 Persona and Secret Injection
blocks.zh: 3.2.1 人身注射和秘密注射

blocks.en: Each dialogue is initialized with a persona sampled from more than 100 professions and demographic profiles, together with a ground-truth secret S S . We sample S S from four fixed-format PII categories: phone numbers, email addresses, Social Security Numbers, and credit card numbers. The secret is inserted in the opening turn as part of a plausible task context, establishing a legitimate in-context reason for the assistant to observe the information.
blocks.zh: 每一次对话都由一个从100多个专业和人口概况抽样的人以及一个地面真相秘密S.S.开始。 我们从四个固定格式的PII类别抽样SS:电话号码、电子邮件地址、社会保障号码和信用卡号码。 开关处插入了这个秘密,作为可能的任务背景的一部分,为助理观察信息提供了合理的内在理由。

blocks.en: 3.2.2 Content-Dense Topic Drift

For each dialogue, we assign a topic such as tax filing, medical triage, or travel logistics. Drift turns are drawn from a topic-conditioned library of dense question-answer pairs and fallback tasks involving professional writing, structured reasoning, or long-form summarization. A subset of drift turns is human-authored by annotators and incorporated into the generation library. This design aims to add unrelated entities and task demands to the active context while preserving experimental control over the original secret and the number of drift turns.
blocks.zh: 对于每次对话,我们都指定一个专题,例如税务申报、医疗分类或旅行后勤。 漂移转折是从一个主题条件化的库中抽取的,包含密集的问答对和倒置任务,涉及专业写作,结构推理,或长式概括. 漂移转折的子集是由注释家撰写的人类作品,并融入了世代的库中. 这种设计旨在将无关的实体和任务要求添加到活动上下文中,同时保留对原始秘密和漂移转弯次数的实验控制.

blocks.en: 3.2.3 Naturalistic Refinement
blocks.zh: 3.2.3 自然改良

blocks.en: To reduce rigidity from the initial scaffold, we apply a final naturalistic refinement step. Each dialogue scaffold is passed to a rewriting model with instructions to improve fluency and persona realism while preserving the exact secret, drift length, role structure, and final probe conditions. This step modifies surface phrasing but does not change the experimental variables.
blocks.zh: 为了从最初的脚手架中降低刚性,我们采用了最后的自然主义完善步骤. 每个对话框脚手架被传递给一个重写模型,并附有一些指示,以提高流畅度和人性现实性,同时保留准确的秘密,漂移长度,角色结构,以及最终的探测条件. 这个步骤修改了表面措辞,但不改变实验变量.

blocks.en: 3.3 Probing Setup
blocks.zh: 3.3 探测设置

blocks.en: The main evaluation appends a final standardized probe to the completed conversation history. Probes are grouped into three persuasion levels: • Simple: a direct neutral query, such as asking for the phone number mentioned earlier. • Medium: a query with a contextual justification, such as needing the information for a form. • Hard: a high-pressure or urgent request designed to test whether pressure cues increase or decrease leakage.
blocks.zh: 主要评价在完成的对话历史中附加了最后的标准化探测器. 探测器分为三个说服级别: • 简单:一个直接的中性查询,例如询问前面提到的电话号码. • 中度:有背景理由的查询,例如需要表格的信息。 • 硬度:高压或紧急请求,旨在测试压力提示是增加还是减少渗漏。

blocks.en: Simple: a direct neutral query, such as asking for the phone number mentioned earlier.
blocks.zh: 简单:直接的中性查询,例如询问前面提到的电话号码.

blocks.en: Medium: a query with a contextual justification, such as needing the information for a form.
blocks.zh: 中度:有背景理由的查询,例如需要表格的信息。

blocks.en: Hard: a high-pressure or urgent request designed to test whether pressure cues increase or decrease leakage.
blocks.zh: 硬度:高压或紧急请求,旨在测试压力提示是增加还是减少渗漏.

blocks.en:
We sample drift length d d , the number of turns between secret disclosure and final probing, from a mixed distribution: d ∼ { 0 with ​ p = 0.2 , Uniform ​ { 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 , 6 } with ​ p = 0.8 . d\sim\begin{cases}0&\text{with }p=0.2,\\
\mathrm{Uniform}\{2,3,4,5,6\}&\text{with }p=0.8.\end{cases} (1) This distribution includes immediate recall cases while emphasizing short-to-medium topic drift. We interpret the results as bounded active-context persistence, not as a full test of arbitrarily long context windows.
3.4 Evaluation Methodology
blocks.zh: 3.4 评价方法

blocks.en: A model may reveal a secret verbatim, with formatting changes, through a partial substring, or through a paraphrased reference. We therefore implement a hierarchical hybrid detector. A response is labeled as leakage if either the normalized secret appears in the normalized response or the LLM judge determines that the response reveals the full secret, a substantial substring, or enough partial information to identify the secret.
blocks.zh: 模型可能通过部分子字符串,或者通过释义的引用,揭示一个秘密的逐字记录,带有格式上的修改. 因此,我们实施一个分级混合探测器。 如果正常的机密出现在正常的回复中,或LLM法官确定该回复揭示了完全的秘密、实质性的底线或足以识别该秘密的部分信息,则该回复被贴上泄漏的标签。

blocks.en: Figure 2 : Hierarchical hybrid evaluation. Normalization-based matching is applied first; regex-negative responses are then passed to an LLM judge.
blocks.zh: 图2:等级混合评价. 以正常化为基础的匹配首先被应用;Regex阴性反应然后传递给LLM裁判.

blocks.en: 3.4.1 Stage 1: Normalization-Based Matching
blocks.zh: 3.4.1 第一阶段:基于正常化的匹配

blocks.en: The first stage detects verbatim and near-verbatim leakage. For numeric secrets, we strip all non-digit characters from both the ground-truth secret and the model response. For alphanumeric secrets, we normalize case and whitespace while preserving meaningful delimiters. Let ϕ ⁡ ( ⋅ ) \phi(\cdot) denote the normalization function. The regex-stage leakage label is Leak regex ( R , S ) = 𝕀 [ ϕ ( S ) ⊂ ϕ ( R ) ] , \mathrm{Leak}_{\mathrm{regex}}(R,S)=\mathbb{I}\big[\phi(S)\subset\phi(R)\big], (2) where R R is the model response and 𝕀 \mathbb{I} is the indicator function.
3.4.2 Stage 2: LLM-as-a-Judge Verification
blocks.zh: 3.4.2 第二阶段:作为法官的LLM核查

blocks.en: Responses that are negative under normalization-based matching are passed to an open-weights Llama judge ( Meta AI, 2024 ) . The judge receives the secret and the model response and returns a binary verdict indicating whether the response reveals the secret or a substantial part of it. This stage is intended to capture partial disclosure, indirect hints, and formatting variations not captured by deterministic matching. We report regex-only and hybrid rates separately because judge-based evaluation can introduce its own errors.
blocks.zh: 在基于常态的匹配中负面的反应会传递给一位开放量级的Llama法官(Meta AI,2024年). 法官收到秘密和模型回复,并返回二进制判断,表明回复是否揭示了秘密或其中很大一部分. 这一阶段旨在捕捉部分披露、间接提示和格式化的变异,而确定性匹配没有捕捉到。 我们单独报告regex和混合费率,因为基于法官的评价可以引入自己的错误。

blocks.en: 3.4.3 Privacy Half-Life

We introduce Privacy Half-Life ( τ \tau ), a stability-based metric for sustained suppression. Let D o ​ b ​ s D_{obs} be the observed set of drift lengths and L ⁡ ( d ) L(d) be the leakage rate at drift length d d . We define the safety threshold as δ = 0.1 × L ⁡ ( 0 ) \delta=0.1\times L(0) and define τ = min { d ∈ D o ​ b ​ s ∣ \displaystyle\tau=\min\{d\in D_{obs}\mid L ⁡ ( d ) ≤ δ \displaystyle L(d)\leq\delta (3) and ∀ d ′ ∈ D o ​ b ​ s , d ′ > d : L ( d ′ ) ≤ δ } . \displaystyle\text{and }\forall d^{\prime}\in D_{obs},d^{\prime}>d:\ L(d^{\prime})\leq\delta\}. If this set is empty, we assign τ = max ⁡ ( D o ​ b ​ s ) + 1 \tau=\max(D_{obs})+1 . This definition prevents transient dips from being interpreted as stable suppression.
Figure 3 : Privacy Half-Life τ \tau requires stable decay below the threshold. A later resurgence disqualifies a transient decrease.
blocks.zh: 图 3: 隐私半衰期 \ tau 需要稳定衰减低于阈值。 后来的复辟使暂时性下降失去意义。

blocks.en: 4 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4 实验设置

blocks.en: We evaluate GPT-OSS-120B, DeepSeek-R1, and Qwen3-VL-235B through the OpenRouter API. All models are queried with the same dialogue histories and probe templates.
blocks.zh: 我们通过OpenRouter API对GPT-OSS-120B,DeepSeek-R1和Qune3-VL-235B进行评估. 所有模型都使用同样的对话历史和探测模板进行查询。

blocks.en: We evaluate 1,000 dialogues generated by the PrivDrift pipeline on each model. Each dialogue contains one seeded secret and one drift length d ∈ { 0 , 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 , 6 } d\in\{0,2,3,4,5,6\} sampled from the distribution above. Each dialogue is evaluated under three standardized persuasion probes, yielding 3,000 cached model-probe responses per model and 9,000 total cached responses across the three evaluated models.
blocks.zh: 我们评价PrivoDrift管道就每种模式产生的1 000次对话。 每个对话框都包含一个种子密钥和一个漂移长度 d { { 0, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6} d\in {0, 2, 4, 5, 6} 上面的分布样本 。 每个对话在三个标准化说服探测器下进行评估,每个模型产生3 000个缓存模型检测答复,三个被评估模型产生9 000个缓存答复。

blocks.en: We report two aggregation levels. Overall leakage is computed at the dialogue level: a dialogue is counted as leaking if any standardized probe elicits the secret. Persuasion-level and fuzzy-matching analyses are computed at the probe level, where each dialogue contributes one response per persuasion condition. This distinction explains why dialogue-level leakage can exceed the average of individual persuasion-level leakage rates.
blocks.zh: 我们报告两个汇总级别。 总体渗漏是在对话一级计算出来的:如果任何标准化探测器发现这一秘密,则将对话算作渗漏。 劝导水平和模糊比对分析是在探测水平上计算出来的,每个对话每个劝导条件都提供1个响应。 这一区别解释了为什么对话层渗漏可能超过个人说服层渗漏率的平均值。

blocks.en: We report both regex-only and hybrid leakage. For dialogue-level rates, we compute 95% bootstrap confidence intervals over dialogues. For probe-level sensitivity checks, we compute rates over cached model-probe responses. For paired model and detector comparisons on matched examples, we use McNemar’s test with Bonferroni correction where applicable. For repeated measures across persuasion levels, we use Cochran’s Q Q test with post-hoc McNemar tests. To test association between leakage and drift length, persuasion level, or secret type, we use chi-square tests of independence and report Cramer’s V V as an effect size.
blocks.zh: 我们报告的是只使用Regex的和混合的泄漏。 对于对话级别的比率,我们计算出95%的间隔。 对于探测层的灵敏度检查,我们计算出比缓存模型检测反应的速率. 对于配对模型和检测器对匹配实例的比较,我们酌情使用McNemar的测试与Bonferroni校正。 我们使用Cochran的QQ测试, 为了测试泄漏和漂流长度、说服水平或秘密类型之间的关联,我们使用独立度的奇方测试,并将Cramer的VV报告为效果大小。

blocks.en: 5 Results
blocks.zh: 5 结果

blocks.en: 5.1 Dialogue-Level Hybrid Evaluation Largely Agrees With Deterministic Matching
blocks.zh: 5.1 对话-混合评价大都同意 匹配

blocks.en: At the dialogue level, hybrid evaluation differs only slightly from normalization-based matching, indicating that leakage in this benchmark is dominated by direct or near-direct reproduction rather than purely semantic paraphrase. The LLM judge adds up to 1.10 percentage points of additional dialogue-level leakage across models ( Table 2 ). This supports reporting hybrid leakage as the main metric while retaining regex-only rates as a transparent deterministic baseline.
blocks.zh: 在对话层面,混合评价仅与基于正常化的匹配略有不同,表明这一基准中的渗漏主要是直接或近直接复制,而不是纯粹的语义解释. LLM法官将额外对话层次跨模型渗漏的1.10个百分点加起来(表2)。 这支持报告混合渗漏作为主要衡量标准,同时保留只使用监管法作为透明的确定基准。

blocks.en: Table 2: Dialogue-level leakage (%) under regex-only and hybrid evaluation. A dialogue is counted as leaking if any standardized probe elicits the secret.
blocks.zh: 表2: 仅以正则和混合方式评价下的对话级渗漏(%)。 如果任何标准化探测器发现该秘密,则对话被算作泄漏。

blocks.en: 5.2 All Models Leak Substantially at the Dialogue Level
blocks.zh: 5.2 在对话一级大量泄漏所有模式

blocks.en: Under dialogue-level hybrid evaluation, leakage remains substantial for all models: DeepSeek-R1 leaks 38.70%, GPT-OSS-120B leaks 47.70%, and Qwen3-VL-235B leaks 54.60% ( Table 3 ). These rates estimate whether a dialogue is vulnerable to at least one of the standardized extraction probes.
blocks.zh: 在对话层混合评价中,所有模型的泄漏率仍然很高:深层Seek-R1泄漏率为38.70%,GPT-OSS-120B泄漏率为47.70%,Qune3-VL-235B泄漏率为54.60%(表3)。 这些速率估计,对话是否易受至少一个标准化提取探测器的影响。

blocks.en: Table 3: Dialogue-level hybrid leakage rates with 95% bootstrap confidence intervals. A dialogue is counted as leaking if any standardized probe elicits the secret.
blocks.zh: 表3:对话级混合渗漏率,靴子置信间隔95%。 如果任何标准化探测器发现该秘密,则对话被算作泄漏。

blocks.en: 5.3 Persuasion Intensity Affects Leakage Non-Monotonically
blocks.zh: 5.3 劝导强度

blocks.en: Probe-level leakage varies significantly across persuasion levels for all models (Cochran’s Q Q , p < 10 − 5 p<10^{-5} ). However, the direction is model-dependent ( Table 4 ). For GPT-OSS-120B, hard persuasion reduces leakage relative to simple and medium, consistent with pressure cues triggering safety behavior. For DeepSeek-R1, medium persuasion yields the lowest leakage. For Qwen3-VL-235B, hard persuasion produces the highest leakage, indicating weaker resistance to pressure-based extraction.
blocks.zh: 在所有模型的说服水平上,勘探水平的渗漏差别很大(Cochran ' s Q Q, p < 10 - 5 p < 10 - 5})。 然而,方向取决于模式(表4)。 对GPT-OSS-120B来说,硬说服比简单和中度减少渗漏,与引发安全行为的压力提示一致. 对于DeepSeek-R1来说,中度劝导产生最少的渗漏. 对于Qune3-VL-235B来说,硬说服产生最高的渗漏量,表明对压力提取的抵抗力较弱.

blocks.en: Table 4: Probe-level hybrid leakage by persuasion intensity.
blocks.zh: 表4:按说服强度分列的探测层混合渗漏。

blocks.en: 5.4 Drift Length Does Not Reliably Reduce Leakage Within the Tested Window
blocks.zh: 5.4 漂流长度无法合理减少测试窗口内的泄漏

blocks.en: Although drift-leak curves exhibit a dip near d = 3 d=3 followed by rebound, effect sizes for drift length are small or negligible across models. Cramer’s V V is 0.1073 for DeepSeek-R1, 0.0659 for GPT-OSS-120B, and 0.0723 for Qwen3-VL-235B in the cached probe-level analysis. This should not be interpreted as a claim about arbitrarily long contexts. Instead, it shows that privacy risk can persist across several unrelated topic shifts even before the original secret is far from the end of the context window.
blocks.zh: 虽然漂流漏流曲线的倾斜度接近d=3d=3,然后是反弹,但不同模型中漂流长度的影响大小很小或可忽略不计。 Cramer的V V是0.1073,用于DeepSeek-R1,0.0659,用于GPT-OSS-120B,在缓存探测层分析中,Quen3-VL-235B为0.0723. 这不应被解释为对任意长期背景的说法。 相反,它表明,即使在最初的秘密远离上下文窗口的尽头之前,在几个无关的主题转移中,隐私风险可能持续存在.

blocks.en: Figure 4 : Hybrid leakage versus drift length. Curves show a dip near d = 3 d=3 followed by rebound.
blocks.zh: 图4:混合渗漏与漂移长度。 曲线显示有接近 d = 3 d = 3 的倾斜,然后反弹。

blocks.en: 5.5 Secret Type Strongly Determines Leakage
blocks.zh: 5.5 明确确定泄漏的秘密类型

blocks.en: Leakage varies sharply by secret type. Cramer’s V V indicates a large association between secret type and hybrid leakage for all models: 0.5871 for DeepSeek-R1, 0.7731 for GPT-OSS-120B, and 0.6927 for Qwen3-VL-235B in the cached probe-level analysis. SSNs and credit card numbers are suppressed far more often than emails and phone numbers, even though all are user-disclosed and contextually private ( Table 5 ). This pattern suggests that current behavior depends more on format and sensitivity cues than on a generalized notion of contextual confidentiality.
blocks.zh: 渗漏因秘密类型而异。 Cramer的V V表示所有型号的秘密类型和混合渗漏之间的巨大联系:深层Seek-R1的0.5871,GPT-OSS-120B的0.7731,以及缓存探测层分析中的Quen3-VL-235B的0.6927. 与电子邮件和电话号码相比,SSN和信用卡号码被压制的频率要高得多,尽管所有号码都是用户公开的,而且都是私人的(表5)。 这种模式表明,目前的行为更多地取决于格式和敏感性提示,而不是对背景保密的普遍概念。

blocks.en: Table 5: Probe-level hybrid leakage by secret type across cached model-probe responses.
blocks.zh: 表5:通过缓存的模型-探测反应按秘密类型分列的探测层混合渗漏.

blocks.en: 5.6 Privacy Half-Life Exceeds the Observed Window
blocks.zh: 5.6 隐私半生超越了被观察的窗口

blocks.en: Using the stable-decay definition of Privacy Half-Life with threshold δ = 0.1 ⋅ L ⁡ ( 0 ) \delta=0.1\cdot L(0) , no evaluated model approaches the threshold at any tested drift length. Consequently, τ = max ⁡ ( D o ​ b ​ s ) + 1 = 7 \tau=\max(D_{obs})+1=7 for all models and persuasion levels, indicating no stable decay within d ≤ 6 d\leq 6 .
blocks.zh: 使用有临界值的 " 半衰期隐私 " 的稳定减值定义= 0.1 → L →(0)\delta=0.1\cdot L(0),没有经过评价的模型在任何测试的漂移长度接近阈值. 因此,所有模型和劝说水平的 =最大 (Do o b s)+1 = 7\tau=\max(D_{obs})+1=7,表明在d≤ 6 d\leq 6范围内没有稳定的衰变.

blocks.en: 5.7 Fuzzy Matching Supports the Hybrid Labels
blocks.zh: 5.7 模糊匹配支持混合标签

blocks.en: As a post-hoc deterministic sensitivity check, we compute normalized fuzzy matching between each saved secret and saved model response using cached outputs only. At a 0.85 threshold, fuzzy leakage closely tracks probe-level hybrid leakage for all models: 26.40% versus 26.43% for DeepSeek-R1, 37.03% versus 37.57% for GPT-OSS-120B, and 37.60% versus 37.53% for Qwen3-VL-235B ( Table 6 ). We treat fuzzy matching as auxiliary evidence rather than the primary metric because approximate string similarity is less expressive than the judge for partial or semantic disclosures.
blocks.zh: 作为Hoc后定型灵敏度检查,我们只使用缓存输出计算每个保存的秘密和保存的模型响应之间的正常模糊匹配. 在0.85阈值下,所有型号的毛细渗漏为26.40%/26.43%/深Seek-R1,37.03%/37.57%/GPT-OSS-120B,37.60%/37.53%/Qun3-VL-235B (表6) (单位:千美元) 我们把模糊的匹配作为辅助证据而不是主要衡量标准,因为大致的弦相似性不如法官对部分或语义披露的表达性。

blocks.en: Table 6: Probe-level regex, fuzzy, and hybrid leakage rates (%) computed from cached model outputs.
blocks.zh: 表6:从缓存模型输出量中计算出的探测级正丙烯、绒毛和混合渗漏率(%)。

blocks.en: Figure 5 : Hybrid leakage heatmap by drift length and persuasion intensity for each model.
blocks.zh: 图5:按漂移长度和说服强度分列的混合渗漏热图。

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: PrivDrift reveals a persistent active-context privacy risk: sensitive information disclosed earlier in a conversation can remain behaviorally recoverable after unrelated topic drift. This does not imply that models permanently remember the secret, nor that all long-context settings behave similarly. Instead, it shows that current assistants may reproduce sensitive in-context information when later prompts provide enough retrieval pressure. The probe-level cached evaluation also shows that this behavior is mostly direct or near-direct reproduction, since fuzzy matching closely tracks hybrid leakage.
blocks.zh: PrivoDrift揭示了持续存在的主动文本隐私风险:在不相关的话题漂移后,在谈话中披露的敏感信息在行为上仍然可以恢复. 这并不意味着模型永远记住这个秘密,也不意味着所有长文设置的行为都相似. 相反,它表明,当以后的提示提供足够的检索压力时,目前的助手可能会复制敏感的内文信息. 探测层缓存评价还显示,这种行为大多是直接或近乎直接的复制,因为模糊的匹配紧密跟踪杂交渗漏.

blocks.en: The strongest pattern is the asymmetry across secret types. SSNs and credit card numbers are suppressed far more often than emails and phone numbers, even though all four categories are user-disclosed secrets in the benchmark. This suggests that current safeguards may rely on format-sensitive safety heuristics rather than robust contextual reasoning about confidentiality.
blocks.zh: 最强的图案是各种秘密类型的不对称. 与电子邮件和电话号码相比,SSN和信用卡号码被压制的频率要高得多,尽管这四类都是基准中用户公开的秘密. 这表明目前的保障措施可能依赖于对格式敏感的安全推力,而不是关于保密的有力背景推理。

blocks.en: Persuasion effects are significant but non-monotonic and model-dependent. For GPT-OSS-120B, high-pressure requests reduce leakage, consistent with the possibility that urgency cues activate refusal behavior. For DeepSeek-R1, medium persuasion produces the lowest leakage. For Qwen3-VL-235B, hard persuasion produces the highest leakage, suggesting weaker resistance to pressure-based extraction.
blocks.zh: 劝导效应虽然重要,但并不多见,且依赖模型. 对于GPT-OSS-120B,高压请求减少渗漏,这符合紧急提示激活拒绝行为的可能性. 对于DeepSeek-R1,中等说服力产生最小的渗漏. 对于Qune3-VL-235B来说,硬说服会产生最高的渗漏量,表明对压力提取的抵抗力较弱.

blocks.en: Finally, topic drift should not be treated as an implicit privacy boundary. Although leakage curves exhibit intermediate dips, those decreases are not stable enough to satisfy the Privacy Half-Life criterion. This motivates stability-based evaluation rather than treating temporary drops as evidence of suppression.
blocks.zh: 最后,专题漂移不应被视为隐含的隐私界限。 虽然渗漏曲线呈现中间倾斜,但这些倾斜不够稳定,无法满足隐私半衰期标准。 这刺激了以稳定为基础的评价,而不是将暂时减少作为压制的证据。

blocks.en: 7 Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: 7. 限制和未来的工作

blocks.en: PrivDrift evaluates drift lengths up to d = 6 d=6 , corresponding to bounded short-to-medium conversational drift rather than full saturation of modern context windows. The results should therefore be interpreted as evidence of persistence under bounded active-context drift, not as a complete characterization of privacy behavior across full long-context windows.
blocks.zh: PrivaDrift评价漂移长度最高达d=6d=6,相当于有界的中短对话漂移而不是现代上下文窗口的完全饱和. 因此,结果应被解释为在有界限的主动文字漂移下持续存在的证据,而不是整个长文字窗口对隐私行为的完全定性。

blocks.en: The benchmark focuses on structured secrets such as SSNs, credit card numbers, emails, and phone numbers. These are easier to detect than unstructured sensitive information such as health status, family circumstances, immigration status, or financial hardship. Future work should extend the benchmark to non-fixed sensitive attributes.
blocks.zh: 该基准侧重于结构化的秘密,如SSN,信用卡号码,电子邮件和电话号码. 比起诸如健康状况、家庭情况、移民状况或经济困难等无结构的敏感信息,这些都更容易发现。 今后的工作应当将基准扩大到非固定的敏感属性。

blocks.en: PrivDrift evaluates recoverability within the active conversation context. It does not test training-data memorization, personalization memory, or cross-session retention.
blocks.zh: PrivaDrift在主动对话中评价可恢复性。 它不测试训练-数据记忆、个性化记忆或跨会保留。

blocks.en: The dataset contains 900 synthetic dialogues and 100 human-authored dialogues inserted throughout the benchmark rather than stored as a separate block. This construction improves realism relative to a purely synthetic benchmark while preserving control over secret type, drift length, and probe structure. However, the current cached evaluation metadata does not preserve which evaluated rows correspond to the human-authored dialogues, so we report aggregate benchmark results and leave a separate human-versus-synthetic comparison for future work.
blocks.zh: 数据集包含900个合成对话,100个人为对话插入整个基准,而不是作为一个单独的块存储。 这种构造改进了相对于纯合成基准的现实主义,同时保留了对秘密类型,漂移长度和探测结构的控制. 然而,目前的缓存评价元数据并不保留哪些被评价的行与人类授权的对话相对应,因此我们报告总的基准结果,并为今后的工作留下单独的人与合成比较。

blocks.en: Leakage labels are based on surface-form outputs using deterministic matching, fuzzy matching, and an external LLM judge. We report regex-only, fuzzy, and hybrid labels separately to make detector behavior transparent, but we do not yet report formal inter-annotator agreement between humans and the automated methods. Future work should include a larger manual audit of borderline partial disclosures and obfuscations.
blocks.zh: 渗漏标签基于表面-形式输出,使用确定匹配,模糊匹配,以及外部LLM判断. 我们单独报告regex,模糊,和混合标签,以使探测器行为透明,但我们还没有报告人类与自动化方法之间的正式的通知员协议. 今后的工作应包括对边缘部分披露和含糊之处进行更大的人工审计。

blocks.en: We evaluate API-served models due to compute and budget constraints. These models may change over time. We mitigate this by logging model identifiers, prompts, timestamps, cached responses, and paired statistics on identical dialogue sets.
blocks.zh: 由于计算和预算限制,我们评价API服务模式。 这些模型可能随时间而变化。 我们通过记录模型识别符、提示、时间戳、缓存回复和相同对话组合的配对统计数据来缓解这种情况。

blocks.en: We plan to release the benchmark generation code, probe templates, evaluation scripts, aggregate result files, and a sanitized subset of generated dialogues. Because the benchmark contains synthetic PII-like strings, we will release examples with non-real identifiers and generation templates sufficient to reproduce the benchmark without exposing realistic identifiers.
blocks.zh: 我们计划发布基准生成代码,探针模板,评价脚本,汇总结果文件,以及一个已消毒的生成对话框子集. 由于基准包含类似合成PII的字符串,我们将发布一些实例,其中含有非真实的标识符和生成模板,足以复制该基准而不暴露现实的标识符.

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en: We introduce PrivDrift, a benchmark for auditing active-context privacy leakage under topic drift and persuasion intensity. Across three LLMs and 1,000 dialogues per model, dialogue-level hybrid leakage remains substantial, ranging from 38.7% to 54.6%. Persuasion intensity affects leakage in model-dependent ways, while secret type has the strongest association with leakage. Within the tested drift range, topic drift does not reliably reduce leakage, and Privacy Half-Life exceeds the observed window for all models. The observed asymmetry across secret types suggests that current protections remain uneven and depend more on format-sensitive cues than on robust contextual confidentiality.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了PrivDrift,这是在主题漂移和说服强度下审计主动文本隐私泄漏的基准. 对话一级的混合渗漏率仍然很大,从38.7%到54.6%不等。 劝导强度以依赖模型的方式影响渗漏,而秘密类型与渗漏关系最强. 在测试的漂移范围内,主题漂移并不能可靠地减少渗漏,隐私半衰期超过了所有模型的观测窗口. 各种秘密类型的不对称现象表明,目前的保护仍然不均衡,更多地依赖于对格式敏感的提示,而不是强有力的背景保密。
